Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint

Class HazelcastSaver.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.HazelcastSaver.Builder
Enclosing class:
HazelcastSaver
public static class HazelcastSaver.Builder extends Object
Builder for HazelcastSaver.

A HazelcastInstance and a StateSerializer are required; the instance may represent an embedded member or a client.

    • hazelcastInstance

      public HazelcastSaver.Builder hazelcastInstance(com.hazelcast.core.HazelcastInstance hazelcastInstance)
      Sets the HazelcastInstance used to obtain the backing map. Required.

      Pass either an embedded member (Hazelcast.newHazelcastInstance(...)) or a thin client (HazelcastClient.newHazelcastClient(...)); the saver does not distinguish.

      Parameters:
      hazelcastInstance - the Hazelcast instance; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder

    • mapName

      public HazelcastSaver.Builder mapName(String mapName)
      Sets the name of the Hazelcast map that holds the checkpoints.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      this builder

    • mapType

      public HazelcastSaver.Builder mapType(HazelcastSaver.MapType mapType)
      Selects the Hazelcast map type. Defaults to HazelcastSaver.MapType.I_MAP.

      HazelcastSaver.MapType.I_MAP uses an IMap (AP, available on the open-source Community Edition). HazelcastSaver.MapType.CP_MAP uses a linearizable CPMap from the CP Subsystem, which requires Hazelcast Enterprise (license + CP Subsystem enabled) at runtime.

      Parameters:
      mapType - the Hazelcast map type; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder

    • stateSerializer

      public <State extends AgentState> HazelcastSaver.Builder stateSerializer(StateSerializer<State> stateSerializer)
      Sets the state serializer used to encode/decode the checkpoints. Required.

      A JacksonStateSerializer stores checkpoints as JSON; any other StateSerializer stores them as Base64-encoded binary.

      Parameters:
      stateSerializer - the state serializer; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder
